{"id":"fedistract-kc30.25","title":"Extract fieldwork::actor_cache module","description":"LRU-style in-memory cache of remote actor public keys. ~100 lines in BS actor_cache.rs, similar pattern in GJ/SH federation.rs.

Source: BS actor_cache.rs (explicit module), cross-ref GJ federation.rs FederationClient.

Public API:
- ActorCache struct — thread-safe cache of remote actor public keys
- ActorCache::new(max_entries: usize, ttl: Duration) -> Self
- ActorCache::get_or_fetch(actor_uri: &str, fetcher: impl Fn(&str) -> Future<Result<RemoteActorData>>) -> Result<CachedActor>
- CachedActor { public_key_pem: String, key_id: String, fetched_at: Instant }

Constants: 24h TTL, 10k max entries, half-life LRU eviction.

What stays in consumers: HTTP client configuration, integration with inbox_verify key resolver callback.

Deps: std only (HashMap, Mutex, Instant). Optional: tokio for async fetch callback.

Note: Must be consistent across all three projects for federation stability.
